objective: Train one shared recurrent continuous-action policy with reinforcement rewards, controlling full requested coil current and gated robot recentering. No supervised imitation or dynamic PI/feedforward underneath the actor.

actions.current: Known loaded-equilibrium current plus normalized full-control request, saturated by actual current/voltage dynamics. No dynamic PI/feedforward command passed to actor.
actions.robot: Learned desired recenter velocity, latched at100Hz and constrained by existing force gates and delay-aware sign/amplitude envelope. Queued commands remain active.

observationsAllowed: Synchronous force/acceleration/relative-position measurements and their causal reconstructions
Estimated normal/sliding reaction, slope and S-A velocity
Previous issued current and robot commands
Force stability gate and robot update phase
Force target, identified masses, fixed orientation, identified mechanical/coil/acquisition/robot parameters
observationsExcluded: True plant force, acceleration, robot motion or current
Bump profile, bump phase, episode elapsed time, future path or preview
Actual hidden calibration errors or friction coefficient
trainingSplit: Separate complete episodes/seeds for training, selection and final native holdout; no final-test retuning. Randomize disturbance timing so recurrence cannot memorize a known bump schedule.
rewardScope: Actual workpiece-normal force and physical metrics allowed only for reward/scoring. Score every native physical tick, including startup, not merely controller-rate samples.
qualification: A completed finite RL attempt is not full-range or hardware qualification. Preserve trained alternatives and failed episodes; canonical promotion requires separate native evidence.

plannedTraining.trainingKind: Reward-driven recurrent PPO; no imitation pretraining

additionalTraining.scope: Decision cadence and exploration changed together; not a pure cadence isolation.
